# Entuned, LLC

> Entuned, LLC is the company behind three ventures in music, media and marketing.

Entuned, LLC is a Wyoming limited liability company. Card statements, invoices and W-9 forms show the company as Entuned, LLC.

## Ventures

- [Signet Artists](https://signetartists.com): Live music for private and corporate events in Colorado, plus event photo and video and artist development.
- [Fractional CMO](https://daniel-fox.com): Marketing consulting.
- [Music Behaviorist](https://danielchristopherfox.com): Writing and research on music and human behavior.

## Pages

- [Home](https://entuned.co/): The company and its ventures.
- [Privacy Policy](https://entuned.co/privacy-policy.html): How Entuned, LLC and its ventures handle personal information.
- [Subscription Terms (archive)](https://entuned.co/pricing/terms.html): The terms that applied to the former Entuned retail music service, which has ended.
